correctness.rationale: The Petersen graph is generated both as the pair-Kneser graph KG(5,2) and independently as GP(5,2). Two separately implemented exact verifiers exhaustively traverse all Bell(10)=115975 unlabeled vertex partitions, using restricted-growth words and 15 exact edge-to-block minimum-distance signatures. Both return zero for block counts 1-3; 40,11965,14877,5045,720,45,1 for 4-10; the 40 minima have profile (1,3,3,3) and form one orbit under 120 label permutations/automorphisms. The direct four-block witness has 15 distinct signatures. The three-block necessary-condition count is independently reproduced (9330,105,15,15). The checker source and saved output are included; these are exhaustive finite checks, not extrapolations.

value.rationale: The original 2023 edge-partition invariant had an unresolved canonical ten-vertex test instance, and a later paper explicitly asserted the wrong minimum value. A reproducible counterexample alone would settle that discrepancy, while the new exhaustive classification gives all 40 optima in one symmetry orbit and all cardinalities up to ten. This supplies an exact benchmark for the emerging invariant, beyond trivial bound substitution or a known vertex-partition census. The superficially equal forty-configuration proper-colouring orbit concerns different block sizes and an independent-set condition, strengthening the need for invariant-specific classification.
